title: Skill
description: One skill attached to an agent. A declaration, not the skill's content: pre-built Anthropic skills are referenced by short name, custom skills by the skill_* id returned when they were uploaded to the workspace. Authoring and uploading a custom skill is out of scope for this build.

name.description: The name this definition knows the skill by. Local label only — the API is given skill_id.

type.description: anthropic for pre-built skills, custom for workspace-authored ones.

skill_id.description: For anthropic skills, the short name (e.g. xlsx). For custom skills, the skill_* id from the workspace.

version.description: Custom skills only. A specific version, or "latest".

then.description: Pre-built Anthropic skills are not versioned by the caller.
